gen-fs-expose-gf-lexend-exa: Striking and compressed, Expose packs its capitals and lowercase almost shoulder to shoulder. Lexend Exa runs on with wide, open curves and a stroke that never changes width, so extended text moves along smoothly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga reads wide and flat, each word loosened by generous tracking. Under the compressed, striking Expose, whole paragraphs of this plain sans would feel unhurried, each line stretched out like spaghetti.
gen-fs-expose-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable Lexend Mega looks drawn with one nib, every c gapped open. What stands out most is the wire-bent, constant thickness of the sans-serif body set against the tight, striking Expose.
gen-fs-expose-gf-lexend-peta: Approachable and sturdy, Lexend Peta holds every curve to a constant, marker-like width. And beside the compressed, striking Expose, extended text in it would feel steady, easygoing, and quick to settle into.
gen-fs-expose-gf-lexend-tera: Expose crowds its lowercase right up against its capitals, striking and compressed. Lexend Tera, in a plotter-pen line with stepping-stone spacing, would carry extended text lightly, with no pinched joins to slow the eye.
gen-fs-expose-gf-lexend-zetta: Expose packs capitals and lowercase tightly, with almost no pause between them. Lexend Zetta, by contrast, spaces its ribbon-like, constant strokes widely, so it handles the text while Expose makes the striking entrance.
gen-fs-expose-gf-liter: Liter draws flat, unmodulated lines with great vertical presence and wide mouths on its round forms. Expose supplies the striking, refined drama; this plain sans does the steady talking.
gen-fs-expose-gf-mada: Mada brings a towering midzone and curves that stubbornly refuse to close. Mada does the quiet work of carrying text, while Expose takes the striking, refined, tightly compressed spotlight.
gen-fs-expose-gf-martel-sans: Tight and striking up top, Expose sits over Martel Sans, whose curves open generously under a high mean line. One grabs attention, the other keeps the text moving smoothly along.
gen-fs-expose-gf-matangi: Expose barely pauses between its lowercase and capitals, compressed and striking. Matangi, drawn like twine pressed flat, feels hefty and relaxed beside it, its curves never thinning at the spine.
